tipoCambio.subtitulo: What one bill from each country is worth. It changes every {{n}} minutes based on the rubric.
tipoCambio.fueraHorario: Outside hours: the rate is on hold until the next session
tipoCambio.regla1: Every {{n}} minutes, during economy hours, each country's rubric points are added up (each grade from 0 to 12 contributes its score ÷ 3).
tipoCambio.regla2: Those points are divided by the students present: that is the index. The target is {{n}}.
tipoCambio.regla3: If the index beats the target, the currency goes up (up to +2.4%); if it falls short, it goes down (up to −1.2%).
tipoCambio.regla4: The rate never drops below {{min}} or rises above {{max}} pesos per bill.
